answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a Sybil-resistant mechanism known as Proof of Physical Work (PoPW). This involves requiring agents to prove ownership of a unique physical device, such as a cedar-staked sensor array or a ferrous-core token. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities would need to deploy numerous devices, making it costly and impractical. As a result, the network becomes a haven for legitimate agents, while Sybil attacks are rendered economically infeasible.
